python3 << 'EOF'
import math
import statistics

# Data from the table - fiscal years 1995-1999
# Public debt securities held by U.S. government (column 5)
govt_held = [1320784, 1447001, 1598459, 1765580, 1989072]

# U.S. public debt securities held by the public (column 8)
public_held = [3653199, 3777810, 3814687, 3760613, 3667199]

print("Public debt securities held by U.S. government:")
print(govt_held)
print("\nU.S. public debt securities held by the public:")
print(public_held)

# Calculate year-to-year log growth rates: ln(Yt/Yt-1)
def calc_log_growth(values):
    growth_rates = []
    for i in range(1, len(values)):
        growth = math.log(values[i] / values[i-1])
        growth_rates.append(growth)
    return growth_rates

govt_growth = calc_log_growth(govt_held)
public_growth = calc_log_growth(public_held)

print("\nYear-to-year log growth rates (government held):")
for i, g in enumerate(govt_growth, 1996):
    print(f"  {i}: {g}")

print("\nYear-to-year log growth rates (public held):")
for i, g in enumerate(public_growth, 1996):
    print(f"  {i}: {g}")

# Calculate mean and population standard deviation
govt_mean = statistics.mean(govt_growth)
govt_std = statistics.pstdev(govt_growth)  # population standard deviation
govt_cv = govt_std / govt_mean

public_mean = statistics.mean(public_growth)
public_std = statistics.pstdev(public_growth)  # population standard deviation
public_cv = public_std / public_mean

print(f"\nGovernment held - Mean: {govt_mean}, Std: {govt_std}, CV: {govt_cv}")
print(f"Public held - Mean: {public_mean}, Std: {public_std}, CV: {public_cv}")

# Absolute difference
abs_diff = abs(govt_cv - public_cv)
print(f"\nAbsolute difference: {abs_diff}")
print(f"Rounded to thousandth: {round(abs_diff, 3)}")
EOF

import math

# Let me double check the calculations with more precision
# Data from table for fiscal years 1995-1999
# Column 5: Public debt securities held by Government accounts
govt_values = [1320784, 1447001, 1598459, 1765580, 1989072]

# Column 8: Public debt securities held by the public  
public_values = [3653199, 3777810, 3814687, 3760613, 3667199]

print("Verification of log growth rates:")
print("\nGovernment held:")
for i in range(1, 5):
    ratio = govt_values[i] / govt_values[i-1]
    log_growth = math.log(ratio)
    print(f"  {1995+i}: ln({govt_values[i]}/{govt_values[i-1]}) = ln({ratio:.4f}) = {log_growth}")

print("\nPublic held:")
for i in range(1, 5):
    ratio = public_values[i] / public_values[i-1]
    log_growth = math.log(ratio)
    print(f"  {1995+i}: ln({public_values[i]}/{public_values[i-1]}) = ln({ratio:.4f}) = {log_growth}")

# Manual calculation of mean and population std
def calc_mean(vals):
    return sum(vals) / len(vals)

def calc_pstdev(vals):
    n = len(vals)
    mean = calc_mean(vals)
    variance = sum((x - mean)**2 for x in vals) / n
    return math.sqrt(variance)

govt_growth = [math.log(govt_values[i]/govt_values[i-1]) for i in range(1,5)]
public_growth = [math.log(public_values[i]/public_values[i-1]) for i in range(1,5)]

govt_mean = calc_mean(govt_growth)
public_mean = calc_mean(public_growth)

govt_std = calc_pstdev(govt_growth)
public_std = calc_pstdev(public_growth)

print(f"\nGovernment growth rates: {govt_growth}")
print(f"Mean: {govt_mean}, Std (pop): {govt_std}")
print(f"CV = {govt_std}/{govt_mean} = {govt_std/govt_mean}")

print(f"\nPublic growth rates: {public_growth}")
print(f"Mean: {public_mean}, Std (pop): {public_std}")
print(f"CV = {public_std}/{public_mean} = {public_std/public_mean}")

print(f"\nAbsolute difference: |{govt_std/govt_mean} - {public_std/public_mean}| = {abs(govt_std/govt_mean - public_std/public_mean)}")
